status: Authoring boundary fixed for this goal; geometry registration and photograph matching remain in progress
coordinates: Metres. Authoring XY: X east, Y north. Native: x=X, z=Y, y=height. Browser: x=X, z=-Y, y=height.
referencePeriod: September 2026 public configuration; leaf-on late summer
boundaryPolicy: This rectangle bounds detailed public space and immediately adjoining street-facing facades. Finish the entire visible facade when the rectangle intersects it; do not cut a building at the boundary. Private interiors and additional blocks remain out of scope. Beyond it, retain economical skyline/rail scenery where visible, with no abrupt ground or horizon seams.

zones.label: Station public complex
zones.scope: Main north building, free passage, public upper spaces, Hachijo station frontage; tracks and platform roofs are visible scenery, not operational or unrestricted playable routes.

zones.label: Karasuma plaza and immediate street faces
zones.scope: Forecourt, transit islands and shelters, pedestrian areas, pavement, planting and adjoining street-facing building facades.

zones.label: Hachijo plaza and immediate street faces
zones.scope: Southern public station frontage, terraces, pedestrian spaces, taxi/bus infrastructure, road margins, planting and adjoining street-facing facades.

zoneLimits: Zone boxes are overlapping work partitions, not cadastral boundaries or claims of public access. Resolve individual edges and circulation with the retained station and municipal plans.
uncertainties: The retained municipal frame aligns existing source assets; independent image/survey residuals remain unmeasured.
LOD0 roof edges establish approximate horizontal building coverage; they do not establish ground-level wall positions, thresholds, or public access.
Multiple records are named Kyoto Station. Use unique sourceBuildingId and GML ID, never name alone.

Source heights and dates can differ by object and acquisition type. The northern complex has measuredHeight 66.3 m and LOD2 local roof max 65.126 m; do not uniformly rescale the current station to that value.
